case_groups.description: Reviewed primary behavior plan for installed batchGitVersion.pm, a batched Git source-version callback module that scans repositories and submodules and derives prefixed blob or MD5 tokens. Applicability is all supported environments; LCOV front ends load it through --version-script for bulk source identity lookup. Runtime dependencies are executable:git, runtime:perl. Required failure coverage includes repository discovery failure, malformed Git output, missing files, incomplete databases after warnings, subprocess failure, and shared token state. No differential evidence is claimed.
